commandDescs.bb: Block the poster of this bug report.
commandDescs.pin: Post a template as a pinned message in a channel.
commandDescs.postUpdateLog: Post an update log in this channel.
commandDescs.ticketStatus: See or change whether people can open new tickets.
commandDescs.ticketCloseCurrent: Close the ticket in this thread.

argDescs.closeBugNote: Add an optional developer note shown to the reporter
argDescs.pinChannel: Channel to post in. Defaults to where you run this.
argDescs.updateTitle: Title of the update. Defaults to today's date.
argDescs.updateImage: Banner image shown under the blurb.
argDescs.updateExtra: Template to add as an extra section.
argDescs.ticketCloseNote: Note sent to the user in their DM when the ticket closes.
argDescs.ticketState: Open or pause new tickets. Leave empty to just see the current status.
argDescs.ticketMessage: Message shown while paused. Type 'default' to go back to the default.
argDescs.updateAs: Name the game the update is posted under. Defaults to Pressure!

bugReports.threadWelcome: 📌 Thank you for submitting a bug report
bugReports.missingHeader: A few things to ensure are here
bugReports.missingIntro: You may have not included the following information, even though the bug report template requires it:
bugReports.missingMedia: **Screenshots or Videos**: Please attach an image or video of the issue you're facing, including your F9 console (PC/Laptop) or `/console` output (Mobile/Tablet). You can also see this by going to `Escape` > `Settings` and scrolling down to the `Open` button.
bugReports.missingPlatform: **Platform**: Please attach where you were playing: PC / Console / Mobile / Tablet.
bugReports.missingDetail: **More Detail**: Please describe what happened, and how to reproduce the issue clearer.
bugReports.missingOutro: Please edit your post to add the missing information, if so. Posts that don't follow the template will be automatically removed after a few hours.
bugReports.dmBlockedTitle: You've been blocked from bug reports
bugReports.resolutionSpamAndBlock: Closed as spam, and the poster has been blocked!
bugReports.dmIntroSpam: > Our development team has reviewed your bug report and closed it without action.
bugReports.dmStatusSpamAndBlock: 🔴 Closed as **spam**, you have been blocked from submitting further bug reports
bugReports.dmDefaultNoteWillFix: This issue has been confirmed and will be fixed when possible.
bugReports.dmDefaultNoteWontFix: This is intended behavior and will not be fixed.
bugReports.dmDefaultNoteSpam: This report was not a valid bug report.
bugReports.dmDefaultNoteSpamAndBlock: This report was not a valid bug report, and you have been blocked from reporting further bugs.
bugReports.dmBlocked: You have been blocked from the bug report forums.
bugReports.dmKicked: You have been blocked from the bug report forums and have been kicked from the server. Please read our policies in bug reports and community conduct before submitting another report
bugReports.dmBanned: You have been blocked from the bug report forums and have been banned from the Urbanshade discord.
bugReports.dmIntroWillFix: > Our development team has reviewed your bug report and has reached a conclusion on the outcome.
bugReports.dmIntroWontFix: > Our development team has reviewed your bug report and has reached a conclusion on the outcome.
bugReports.dmIntroNotEnoughInfo: > Our development team has reviewed your bug report, but there was not enough information provided for us to investigate it.
bugReports.dmIntroSpamAndBlock: > Our development team has reviewed your bug report and closed it without action.
bugReports.dmDefaultNoteNotEnoughInfo: This report does not contain enough information for us to reproduce or investigate the issue.
bugReports.dmOutroWillFix: We appreciate the time you have taken to submit this bug report. If you would like to submit another bug report, please do so [here]({{FORUM_URL}}).
bugReports.dmOutroWontFix: We appreciate the time you have taken to submit this bug report. If you would like to submit another bug report, please do so [here]({{FORUM_URL}}).
bugReports.dmOutroNotEnoughInfo:
Please submit a new report [here]({{FORUM_URL}}) with as much detail as you can: step-by-step instructions to reproduce the bug, what you expected to happen instead, and a screenshot or video if possible.

**No action has been taken against you.** Please note that repeatedly submitting reports without enough information may result in your access to the bug forums being restricted.
bugReports.dmOutroSpam: We appreciate the time you have taken to submit this bug report. If you would like to submit another bug report, please do so [here]({{FORUM_URL}}).
bugReports.dmOutroSpamAndBlock: You have been blocked from the bug report forums and will not be able to submit further reports.
